response.original_title: Boris Johnson: Into Ukraine’s Kill Zone
response.overview: Boris Johnson: Into Ukraine’s Kill Zone is a 67-minute Channel 5 documentary following former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson on a 72-hour assignment to Ukraine’s front lines in the Zaporizhzhia region. Reverting to his journalistic roots, Johnson embeds near active fighting to report on the conflict. Key Highlights  * Frontline Access: Johnson travels incognito—wearing a balaclava and staying in non-descript apartments—to visit frontline towns like Komyshuvakha and Huliaipole.  * Operations: He inspects secret drone workshops, hidden bomb factories, and spends freezing night shifts with the 112th Territorial Defence Brigade hunting Russian Shahed drones with vintage machine guns.  * Political Message: Framing the war as "good versus evil," Johnson criticizes Western complacency and calls for urgent heavy weaponry support. Reception Critics offered mixed reviews, ranging from five stars in The Daily Mail to four stars in The Telegraph and one star in The Guardian.
response.title: Boris Johnson: Into Ukraine’s Kill Zone
